title: carlina corymbosa var. graeca
intro: Carlina corymbosa var. graeca, commonly known as Graecian Hawksbeard, is a perennial plant species belonging to the sunflower family (Asteraceae). It has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions, such as digestive issues and inflammation, due to its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Carlina corymbosa var. graeca are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system, exhibit antioxidant activity, and display analgesic and anti-inflammatory effects. The bioactive constituents responsible for these properties include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal and therapeutic potential.
